description: Crossplane drawer and relationship graph plus licence compliance: Dashboard.tsx 'crossplane' drawer branch with sequence guard and no Delete, DrawerDetailsRenderer case, CrossplaneResourceDetails (category with null fallback), CrossplaneDetailSections following the AM-2 table via resolveDrawerRefs, CrossplaneTreeGraph/GraphNode/TreeList, and public/licenses/crossview-LICENSE.txt with attribution headers. Implements plan.md items 16-18; design B.1, B.7 (renderer), B.9 (Dashboard/DrawerDetailsRenderer rows, Drawer data flow), AM-1 (null category -> generic sections only), AM-2. Depends on FEAT-001..003.
steps: Read design.md B.1, B.7, B.9 rows for Dashboard.tsx/DrawerDetailsRenderer/CrossplaneResourceDetails/CrossplaneDetailSections/visualizers, B.9 'Drawer data flow', AM-1 item 5, AM-2; plan.md items 16-18; prior FEAT findings.

src/components/Dashboard.tsx (git status + re-read; additive only): add 'crossplane' to the handleResourceClick type union (not the include-list); `const crossplaneDrawerSeq = useRef(0);` next to other refs; first line of handleResourceClick `const drawerSeq = ++crossplaneDrawerSeq.current;`; early-return Crossplane branch right after setDrawerTab('details') exactly as B.9 (getResource(clusterName, toCrossplaneRef(resource)), seq-guarded setDetailedResource, error object); Delete button condition adds `&& type !== 'crossplane'`; pass onOpenCrossplaneResource={(ref) => handleResourceClick(ref, 'crossplane')} to DrawerDetailsRenderer; ErrorBoundary resetKey appends `-${selectedResource?.kind ?? ''}`.

src/components/dashboard/DrawerDetailsRenderer.tsx (re-read; additive): optional prop onOpenCrossplaneResource?: (ref: CrossplaneObjectRef) => void and `case 'crossplane'` rendering CrossplaneResourceDetails with { clusterName, object: detailedResource, refHint: selectedResource, onOpenResource }.

Create src/components/resources/details/CrossplaneResourceDetails.tsx: category = classifyCrossplaneObject(object, definitionsPayload) ?? refHint.category ?? null (never default to 'managed'); null -> only banner via deriveHealth('generic'), conditions table, (events/YAML are already provided by the drawer); health banner with deciding reason/message; conditions table; extras looked up by crossplaneKey(object) from getPackages/getDefinitions/getComposites via useCrossplaneQuery({autoRefresh:false}) per B.9 'Drawer data flow' (skeleton while loading, 'Not in the current snapshot', inline error); Details | Relationships toggle for claim/composite/managed (Graph | List), disabled with title 'Object has no apiVersion/kind/name' when fields missing; getTree called with toCrossplaneRef(...).

Create src/components/resources/details/CrossplaneDetailSections.tsx rendering exactly the AM-2 table sections per category, with links from resolveDrawerRefs (link -> onOpenResource(ref); DrawerLink without ref -> plain font-mono text; Secret refs never links). Revisions table for packages uses RevisionRow with packageRevision category refs.

Create src/components/resources/visualizers/CrossplaneTreeGraph.tsx (ResourceTopology.tsx pattern: useNodesState/useEdgesState, fitView, Background, Controls, h-[500px], memoised nodeTypes { crossplane: CrossplaneGraphNode }, nodes from buildCrossplaneFlow, onNodeClick -> onOpenResource except summary/notFetched, truncation banner 'Showing first 300 resources', warnings muted note, red card with Retry on root failure), CrossplaneGraphNode.tsx (220px bg-[#1e1e1e] card, uppercase kind, truncated name with title, namespace, Synced/Ready pills or state badge, health-coloured left border, text always present), CrossplaneTreeList.tsx (ul role='tree', aria-level, keyboard navigation).

Fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crossplane-contrib/crossview/84436218ccdcacc27d41fac63b3bb77fe232c9af/LICENSE and write it verbatim to public/licenses/crossview-LICENSE.txt. Confirm the B.1 attribution header is present at the top of src/utils/crossplane-utils.ts, src/utils/crossplane-summaries.ts, src/utils/crossplane-drawer-refs.ts and electron/crossplane-discovery.ts (add if missing).

No `any` in new files. MODIFIED (additive str_replace only): src/components/Dashboard.tsx (import toCrossplaneRef; crossplaneDrawerSeq ref next to activeViewRef; `const drawerSeq = ++crossplaneDrawerSeq.current;` first line of handleResourceClick; early-return seq-guarded crossplane branch after setDrawerTab('details') exactly as B.9; Delete condition adds `&& selectedResource.type !== 'crossplane'`; onOpenCrossplaneResource passed to DrawerDetailsRenderer; ErrorBoundary resetKey appends -kind). The 'crossplane' type-union token was already added by FEAT-003. The user's large parallel Dashboard.tsx changes (resource store etc.) are untouched. src/components/dashboard/DrawerDetailsRenderer.tsx (was clean at HEAD): imports, optional onOpenCrossplaneResource prop, `case 'crossplane'` -> CrossplaneResourceDetails {clusterName, object, refHint: selectedResource, onOpenResource, onExplain, onOpenYaml}; the only touched existing line is a trailing comma after onDeleteNode in the destructuring. BEHAVIOUR: category = classifyCrossplaneObject(object, definitions) ?? refHint.category ?? null (never defaults to managed). Because the classifier returns 'managed' for any non-core group when the XRD list is missing, a 'managed' result before definitions load uses the hint, or shows a pending skeleton until definitions settle; after a definitions error it keeps the classifier result. null -> banner via deriveObjectHealth('generic'), conditions table, and CrossplaneDetailSections renders nothing (default case). Extras: package categories (+packageRevision) from getPackages, xrd/composition/compositionRevision from getDefinitions + getComposites, looked up by crossplaneKey(object); managed also loads getPackages only for the providerConfig link. Inline skeleton / 'Not in the current snapshot' / inline red error. Links from resolveDrawerRefs (detection from detect(); a stub with empty kindVersions while it loads, so links degrade to text); a DrawerLink without ref renders as font-mono text, so Secret refs are never links. Package revisions table uses makeLink('Revision', RevisionRow) (category packageRevision). Details | Relationships toggle for claim/composite/managed, Relationships disabled with title 'Object has no apiVersion/kind/name' when fields are missing; Graph | List inner toggle; getTree(clusterName, toCrossplaneRef(...)) via useCrossplaneQuery(autoRefresh:false, enabled only on the Relationships tab). Graph: useNodesState/useEdgesState, memoised nodeTypes {crossplane}, fitView, Background, Controls, h-[500px], onNodeClick opens except summary/notFetched (and refs failing isValidCrossplaneRef), 'Showing first 300 resources' banner when truncated, warnings as muted notes, red card with Retry on root failure. List: ul role=tree, treeitems with aria-level/setsize/posinset/expanded/selected, roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Space. No Delete or other mutating action in the drawer for type 'crossplane'. Attribution headers confirmed in crossplane-utils.ts, crossplane-summaries.ts, crossplane-drawer-refs.ts, electron/crossplane-discovery.ts (no edits needed).
